name: Cardsharp
author: Wickedlizerd
description: An all-in-one mod menu. Press F1 during a run (or use the Cardsharp button in the pause menu) to spawn any joker, consumable, voucher, booster or tag; forge custom playing cards; change editions, enhancements, seals and stickers on any card; edit money, hands, discards, ante, slots and hand levels; pick boss blinds; toggle cheats; and save or load run snapshots.
